Take a shelter dog out for the day in Virginia

Want to rent or borrow a dog in Virginia? These shelters let you take an adoptable dog on a day trip, hike or sleepover for free. 2 shelter programs in Virginia, 2 of them open to the public. Cities include Chesapeake, Richmond.

Other shelters in Virginia

These shelters don't run a day-out program that we know of yet. Want to take one of their dogs out? Send a request. Once a month we tell each shelter how many people asked, with a free guide to starting a program.

ShelterDayOut is a free directory. We don't run outings or handle bookings; each shelter sets its own rules. Listings are checked monthly, but details change, so confirm with the shelter before you go.
